_doc: On-screen controls for phones and tablets (src/client/touch.ts). stick: the virtual stick on the left, which appears where the thumb lands: radius (CSS px) the knob travels, dead (of the radius) before it reads, diagonal: how far off an axis a push still counts on the other axis too (0..1 of the radius). buttons: the I, J, K and L diamond on the right (at: n, w, e, s), each a Btn action, its letter (the player's rebound letter shows instead when it is one) and its word; pills: the smaller buttons beside it (step off, revert, powerslide); menu: the menu button; rotate: the line suggesting landscape on a portrait screen (while skating, never over a menu; once dismissed, never again; it fades by itself rotateSeconds after it first shows).
rotate: Sideways is better: the park is wide.
